verdict.rationale: The ADK docs say the framework is 'designed to be written by both humans and AI'. They also invite users to connect a coding assistant to ADK developer Skills and 'AI-aware developer resources', which shows agent-oriented docs exist. The probes returned 404 for llms.txt at the google.github.io root and for a .md variant of the get-started page. Those paths sit outside the adk-docs site, so they neither confirm nor concretely contradict an llms.txt. Missing for 10: a confirmed llms.txt or markdown docs endpoint, specifics on what the AI-aware resources contain and how an agent consumes them, and independent hands-on corroboration.
